title: Eclipse Sorcerer on Deck
description: A skeletal wizard with long white hair and golden spectacles stands on an ornate wooden observatory deck, wearing a flowing dark blue and red starry cloak. Behind him a massive solar eclipse radiates golden and purple light against a starry sky with green aurora, framed by an intricate celestial arch decorated with moons and stars.
prompt: A skeletal wizard with flowing white hair and golden spectacles stands on an ornate wooden deck under a massive solar eclipse. He wears a long dark blue cloak with red starry lining that billows dramatically. Behind him the eclipse radiates intense golden and purple light with green aurora borealis visible in the starry night sky. The scene is framed by an intricate celestial metal arch decorated with moon and star motifs, highly detailed fantasy illustration.
